earnings.title: Arxis Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance
highlights: Revenue of $501 million increased 25% year-over-year, including 21% organic growth, reflecting broad-based strength across all of our key end markets.

quotes.text: We continued to execute our disciplined, repeatable acquisition strategy during the quarter with the acquisition of MagCanica and the announced acquisition of Omnetics.
quotes.by: Kevin Perhamus, President and Chief Executive Officer of Arxis
